chunks.title: Flagship Project: SATRK Overview & SIH 2026 Purpose
chunks.content: SATRK ('One step ahead of every scam.') is Ritesh Chaudhari's flagship cyber defense project for SIH 2026 (Smart India Hackathon). Purpose: SATRK is an end-to-end cyber defense system built for Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026 to help detect and respond to modern Indian telecommunication and financial scams, especially digital arrest and authority impersonation scams. Core Problems Targeted: Digital Arrest / Virtual Isolation scams, Police / CBI / Cyber Cell / Supreme Court impersonation, TRAI SIM-disconnection threats, Customs / FedEx drug-seizure threats, Bank account / UPI / KYC blockade threats, AI voice cloning / deepfake voice scams, Malicious links in SMS/chat messages.

chunks.title: SATRK Live Call Audio Pipeline & Android Monitoring
chunks.content: SATRK Core Pipeline: Android App (TelephonyManager / CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK / AudioRecord) -> PCM Audio over WebSocket -> FastAPI WebSocket Router -> STT Service using Groq Whisper (whisper-large-v3) -> Indian-language speech to English translation -> Parallel Analysis (Rule Engine + Groq LLM contextual reasoning + Resemble AI voice-clone detection) -> Unified Event Stream -> Dashboard UI. The Android app monitors active calls using TelephonyManager (CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK / CALL_STATE_IDLE) and streams PCM audio over WebSockets only during active calls.

chunks.title: SATRK Multilingual STT & Speech Analysis (Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Hinglish)
chunks.content: Multilingual Capability: Supports Indian multilingual speech analysis during live call audio processing, including Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, and Hinglish. Groq Whisper (whisper-large-v3) translates speech into structured English text with RMS silence filtering, regex post-filtering, and repetitive-token detection. Groq Whisper (whisper-large-v3) processes Indian speech (Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Hinglish) into structured English text with RMS silence filtering and hallucination post-filtering during live call audio analysis.

chunks.title: SATRK Scam Reasoning & Verdicts (Rule Engine + Groq LLM)
chunks.content: SATRK Scam Reasoning: Combines a deterministic Rule Engine (regex/keyword signals) and Groq LLM contextual reasoning (openai/gpt-oss-20b prompt-engineered for Indian scam typologies). Produces SAFE, WARNING, or SCAM verdicts with percentage risk score, detected scam signals, and defensive advice. Dual detection layers combine a deterministic Rule Engine and Groq LLM contextual reasoning to return SAFE, WARNING, or SCAM verdicts with risk score percentage, signals, and defensive advice.

chunks.title: SATRK Voice Deepfake & Clone Detection (Resemble AI)
chunks.content: Voice Deepfake Detection: Voice authenticity analysis powered by Resemble AI API is activated when call risk reaches THREAT_THRESHOLD >= 50.0. If a possible voice clone is detected, a possible_voice_clone signal is added and overall risk score is boosted by +10%. Not every call is automatically deepfake-verified. Resemble AI detection API activates when THREAT_THRESHOLD >= 50.0, adding possible_voice_clone signal and boosting risk score by +10%.

chunks.title: SATRK Malicious Link & SMS Scanner (Google Safe Browsing API v4)
chunks.content: Malicious Link Scanning: Scans URLs extracted from SMS/chat messages using Google Safe Browsing API v4 across threat categories: MALWARE, SOCIAL_ENGINEERING, UNWANTED_SOFTWARE, and POTENTIALLY_HARMFUL_APPLICATION. Analyzes URLs from SMS/chat using Google Safe Browsing API v4 for MALWARE, SOCIAL_ENGINEERING, UNWANTED_SOFTWARE, and POTENTIALLY_HARMFUL_APPLICATION.

chunks.title: SATRK Asynchronous Architecture, Performance & Feedback Loop
chunks.content: Performance Architecture: Designed as a low-latency asynchronous pipeline with parallel AI processing (AsyncGroq, httpx.AsyncClient, asyncio.gather) and strict 3.5-second upstream timeouts for external AI calls with graceful degradation to Rule Engine results. Audio is streamed only during active calls. Feedback Loop: Human-in-the-loop Yes/No feedback mechanism on high-risk alerts logged to refine rule weights, prompt calibration, and detection behavior (model is not automatically retrained per event). Designed as a low-latency asynchronous pipeline with parallel AI processing (asyncio.gather) and 3.5s timeouts with graceful degradation to Rule Engine.

chunks.title: Ritesh Chaudhari's Role & Contributions in SATRK
chunks.content: Ritesh Chaudhari's Contribution to SATRK: Ritesh Chaudhari served as the Lead AI Engineer, Cybersecurity Developer, and System Architect for SATRK. He designed the low-latency WebSocket PCM audio streaming pipeline, integrated Groq Whisper (whisper-large-v3) STT with RMS silence and repetition filtering, built the dual-engine scam reasoning system (Rule Engine + Groq LLM), implemented Resemble AI voice deepfake detection, and integrated Google Safe Browsing URL scanning.

chunks.title: SATRK Engineering Challenges & Technical Solutions Solved by Ritesh
chunks.content: Key Engineering Challenges Solved in SATRK: Android VOICE_CALL recording restrictions: Bypassed using TelephonyManager (CALL_STATE_OFFHOOK) and microphone PCM AudioRecord streaming strictly during active calls. | Whisper STT hallucination & repetition loops: Eliminated using RMS silence threshold filtering and regex post-processing. | Upstream API stalls/timeouts: Solved by implementing strict 3.5s timeouts with asyncio.gather parallel execution and graceful fallback to deterministic Rule Engine. | Code-switched Indian speech: Accurately transcribed and translated Indian multilingual speech (Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Hinglish) into structured English scam signals. | User Privacy & Security: Audio is streamed ephemerally over WebSockets only during active calls without persistent raw audio recording.
